conclusion_reason: The answer correctly finds a breach of section 27 paragraph 1 with the section 83 administrative fine of up to three million baht and civil liability under sections 77-78, but its bottom line also asserts criminal liability under section 79 without the condition that the data be section 26 sensitive data, which the facts do not show.

problems.quote: บริษัทในฐานะผู้ควบคุมข้อมูลส่วนบุคคลจึงต้องรับผิดทั้งทางอาญา (มาตรา 79) ... การขายข้อมูลให้บุคคลภายนอก...จึงเข้าข่ายวรรคสอง
problems.why: Section 79 punishes a breach of section 27 only when it concerns personal data under section 26 (sensitive data). The answer applies it to ordinary customer data without that condition, although it applies the same condition correctly to section 84.
